description: Basic role/user metadata, GRANT/REVOKE table/schema privileges, and privilege function introspection
cleanup_sql: REVOKE USAGE ON SCHEMA public FROM diff_analyst;
sql: CREATE TABLE diff_roles_privileges (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, label TEXT);
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO diff_analyst;
GRANT SELECT ON TABLE diff_roles_privileges TO diff_analyst;
SELECT rolname, rolcanlogin::text AS rolcanlogin, rolcreatedb::text AS rolcreatedb FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'diff_analyst';
SELECT usename FROM pg_catalog.pg_user WHERE usename = 'diff_app_user';

SELECT has_schema_privilege('diff_analyst', 'public', 'USAGE')::text AS schema_usage, has_table_privilege('diff_analyst', 'diff_roles_privileges', 'SELECT')::text AS table_select, has_table_privilege('diff_analyst', 'diff_roles_privileges', 'INSERT')::text AS table_insert;
SELECT grantee, table_name, privilege_type FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE grantee = 'diff_analyst' AND table_name = 'diff_roles_privileges';
REVOKE SELECT ON TABLE diff_roles_privileges FROM diff_analyst;
